summary.text: Jeremy Zellner is a member of the New York State Senate representing District 61, which includes parts of Buffalo, Tonawanda, Amherst and Grand Island, and he took office on February 4, 2026, after winning a special election.
Wikipedia says he is also chair of the Erie County Democratic Committee and was commissioner of the Erie County Board of Elections from 2017 to 2026.

paragraphs.text: Wikipedia says Zellner was born and raised in Tonawanda, in a single-parent household, and that his father and grandfather were autoworkers and United Auto Workers members.
He graduated from Buffalo State University with a bachelor's degree in political science.
He joined the Erie County Democratic Party as a volunteer in 2003 and became party chair in 2012, succeeding Leonard Lenihan, according to Wikipedia.
He served on the Hillary for America National Finance Committee in 2016 and was a delegate to the 2016 and 2024 Democratic National Conventions.

He resigned as elections commissioner in January 2026 to run in the special election created when Sean Ryan was elected mayor of Buffalo and resigned his Senate seat, and he defeated Dan R. Gagliardo.
